title: Triad SDK ergonomic retry templates and stream helper shims
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: Engineers building long-lived streaming integrations across Python/TypeScript/Go repeatedly reimplement retry logic and ad-hoc backoff glue. That results in subtle behavioral drift between SDKs and brittle consumer ergonomics when streams need to be paused, reauthenticated, or resumed during transient failures. This PR introduces a small, explicit "retry template" surface plus a lightweight stream-consumer helper library (triad-stream-helpers) to provide consistent defaults and ergonomics across the three SDKs. Summary of changes: 1) Add retry template definitions (fast-fail, conservative, balanced) expressed as declarative profiles with windows, jitter, and idempotency hints. Templates are compiled down to SDK-specific policy objects at build-time for TypeScript and Go and at import-time for Python to keep runtime cost low. 2) Introduce stream consumer helpers: pauseable async iterator wrappers, token-rotation callbacks, and a resumeHints API that surfaces whether a resumed connection can safely reuse the previous KV-cache. 3) Small public API additions: RetryProfiles enum (Py/TS/Go), StreamHelpers.attachResumeHints(stream, opts), and a new RetryConfig.fromTemplate(name, overrides). 4) Cross-language tests and examples in examples/triad-retry/ demonstrating a canary reconnection flow and a long-lived chat consumer. 5) Version bumps: redwood-sdk-python -> 2.0.0-rc1, redwood-sdk-typescript -> 1.30.0, redwood-sdk-go -> v1.9.0. Compatibility & migration: This is intentionally additive; existing RetryConfig constructors remain supported. Consumers that opt into templates will get consistent defaults across SDKs. Important migration notes are included in the release_notes field below. Checklist: - [x] Design doc reviewed (ENG-1987) - [x] Cross-SDK API alignment session with SDK leads - [x] Unit + integration tests for reconnection scenarios - [x] Examples and README updates - [x] Telemetry counters for retry decisions included - [x] Docs site snippets staged. How to review: Focus on the template semantics (the JSON/YAML-like canonical template) and the cross-SDK mapping layer. For Python, inspect cost of import-time compilation; for TS/Go, focus on compile-time bundling and tree-shaking behaviour. Tests: Included unit tests for 12 reconnection permutations and an integration canary that ran on the internal perf-lab. CI notes: initial CI run showed a flaky TS e2e (timeout in node12 matrix) which was fixed by increasing the test harness timeout, rerun green. Runbook: If consumers see resumed streams misapply KV-cache, the StreamHelpers.attachResumeHints will log a diagnostic telemetry event under telemetry.retry.resume_hint_mismatch and fall back to a safe cold-start. Related: ENG-2034 work on credential windows and session-lease informs the token-rotation callback surface.

release_notes: Add new RetryProfiles templates (fast-fail, balanced, conservative) and a lightweight triad stream helper library available across Python (2.0.0-rc1), TypeScript (1.30.0) and Go (v1.9.0). These additions are additive: existing RetryConfig constructors are unchanged. Users who adopt templates can opt into consistent retry windows and resume semantics across SDKs. Notable: StreamHelpers.attachResumeHints now surfaces whether resumed connections can reuse KV cache; consumers should handle 'unsafe' by reinitializing state. Upgrade guides: - Python: import RetryProfiles from redwood.retry_templates and call RetryConfig.fromTemplate('balanced') - TypeScript: import { RetryProfiles } from '@redwood/sdk/stream-helpers' - Go: use retry.NewFromTemplate("balanced") in your client setup.
testing_instructions: Run unit tests in each SDK folder (pytest, npm test, go test). Integration canary: examples/triad-retry/* simulate interrupted stream for 30s and verify telemetry.retry.* counters increment according to template. To reproduce earlier CI flake: run TS e2e suite under node12 timing constrained; increasing harness timeout by 50% resolved the timeout in this branch.
notes_for_ops: Telemetry keys added: telemetry.retry.template_applied, telemetry.retry.attempt, telemetry.retry.resume_hint_mismatch. Ops should add these to the per-tenant dashboard for early detection of mismatch between resumeHints and observed model KV cache miss rates.
summary: Merged a cross-SDK feature that standardizes retry templates and improves streaming ergonomics with small, additive API shims and examples. Ship-ready and tested across unit/integration suites.
